Which grades have the most public school students nationwide?

SELECT grade, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rural health clinic cost reports cover fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_rhc17_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which power plants have the biggest single generating units?

SELECT plant_name, state, technology, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS largest_unit_mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
How many votes were cast for president in Wisconsin in 2016?
SELECT sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'WISCONSIN' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2016'
Where in a patent are compounds found most often: description, claims, abstract, title or images?

SELECT f.field_name, count(*) AS mentions FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patent_compound_map AS m JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_fields AS f ON cast(f.id AS varchar) = cast(m.field_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Georgia's 2020 presidential vote was cast by mail?

SELECT mode, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'GEORGIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which car makes draw the most owner complaints to federal safety regulators?
SELECT maketxt, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many power plants report a coal ash impoundment?
SELECT count(DISTINCT plant_code) AS plants FROM govblock_energy.eia860_plant_y_sheet_plant WHERE ash_impoundment = 'Y'
Which tax-exempt organisations hold the most assets?
SELECT name, state, try_cast(asset_amt AS double) AS assets FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of U.S. patents are design patents rather than utility patents?
SELECT patent_type, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which industries hold the most water discharge permits?
SELECT sic_desc, count(DISTINCT npdes_id) AS permits FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_sics GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who bought the mortgages lenders made in 2023: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, Ginnie Mae or nobody?

SELECT CASE cast(purchaser_type AS varchar) WHEN '0' THEN 'not sold' WHEN '1' THEN 'Fannie Mae' WHEN '2' THEN 'Ginnie Mae' WHEN '3' THEN 'Freddie Mac' WHEN '4' THEN 'Farmer Mac' WHEN '5' THEN 'private securitiser' WHEN '6' THEN 'bank or savings association' WHEN '71' THEN 'credit union or mortgage company' WHEN '72' THEN 'life insurer or credit union' ELSE 'other' END AS buyer, count(*) AS loans, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which reactors' operating licences run out soonest?
SELECT plant_name_unit_number AS reactor, operating_license_expires FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 ORDER BY try_cast(operating_license_expires AS date) ASC LIMIT 10
How many people in the Bronx live below the poverty line?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36005' AND variable = 'B17001_E002'
Which cities are served by the most separate water systems?

SELECT concat(city_served, ', ', state_served), count(DISTINCT pwsid) AS systems FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_geographic_areas WHERE city_served IS NOT NULL AND concat(city_served, ', ', state_served) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pages does a government form run on average?
SELECT avg(pages) AS average FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE pages > 0
Which hospitals received the most Medicare inpatient payments in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_org_name AS hospital, rndrng_prvdr_state_abrvtn AS state, round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double))) AS medicare_paid FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What was ERCOT's peak hourly electricity demand in 2023?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id = 'EBA.ERCO-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '2023%'
Which counties lost the most residents in 2024?
SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(npopchg2024 AS double) AS change FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '50' ORDER BY 3 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the highest system-wide hourly load in ERCOT's weather-zone forecasts?
Ercot Load Forecast By Weather Zone Cdr Lfcweathernp
SELECT max(try_cast(systemtotal AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.ercot_load_forecast_by_weather_zone_cdr_lfcweathernp
In which languages does ChEBI give the most international nonproprietary names?
SELECT language_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_names WHERE type = 'INN' AND language_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal defect investigations have involved Tesla vehicles?
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS investigations FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_investigations WHERE c2 = 'TESLA'
Where is sub-award work carried out most, state by state?

SELECT place_of_perform_state_name, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE coalesce(place_of_perform_state_name, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were more patent applications filed in 2015 or in 2023?
SELECT substr(filing_date, 6, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE substr(filing_date, 6, 4) IN ('2015', '2023') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which therapeutic areas draw the most industry research payments?

SELECT product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_research WHERE product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1 <> '' AND product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Democrats and Republicans sit in New York's legislature?
SELECT party, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE state_file LIKE 'ny-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which companies hold the most approved drug products?
SELECT applicant_full_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE applicant_full_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many fatal crashes in 2022 happened at railroad crossings?
SELECT count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND rail NOT IN ('0000000', '9999999', '')
Which states have the most judicial positions on record?
SELECT location_state, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE position_type = 'jud' AND coalesce(location_state, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of recorded solar installations change from 2012 to 2022?

SELECT substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
What were the largest withdrawals from the Treasury's cash account over fiscal 2024?

SELECT transaction_catg, try_cast(transaction_fytd_amt AS double) AS millions FROM govblock_treasury.deposits_withdrawals_operating_cash WHERE record_date = '2024-09-30' AND transaction_type = 'Withdrawals' AND transaction_catg NOT LIKE '%Total%' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many links between candidates and their committees has the FEC recorded?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.candidate_committee_linkages
Which industries do prime awards that pass work to sub-awardees come from most often?
SELECT naics_description, count(*) AS subawards FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE naics_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many published applications came through the international PCT route?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_pct_data
